title: Fragments and Frames
text:
Postmodern fiction often refuses to offer a stable narrative centre, and Italo Calvino's If on a winter's night a traveler is a notable example. The novel opens by addressing the reader directly, then repeatedly interrupts its own story to begin new ones. Such fragmentation forces the reader to become an active participant rather than a passive recipient of meaning. The technique is often read as a commentary on the act of reading itself.

Yet experimental structures are not merely playful. Many critics argue that the disruption of linear plot exposes assumptions about authority, identity and truth that conventional realism leaves unexamined. By drawing attention to its own artifice, the text reminds the reader that every narrative is constructed. The result is a work that is both entertaining and intellectually demanding.

questions.text: According to paragraph one, how does the novel begin?
options: With a long description of a winter landscape
With a letter written by a critic
With a dialogue between two characters

questions.text: According to paragraph two, what do many critics argue about the disruption of linear plot?
options: It makes the novel easier to follow
It exposes assumptions about authority, identity and truth
It is a simple way to avoid writing an ending
It removes the need for a reader

questions.text: What can be inferred about the author's view of conventional realism?
options: He considers it the only valid form of fiction
He believes it leaves important assumptions unexamined
He thinks it is more entertaining than experimental fiction
He regards it as impossible to write

questions.text: What is the most likely implication of the passage's claim that the text reminds the reader that every narrative is constructed?
options: Readers should trust all stories without question
Readers are encouraged to become more critical of how meaning is produced
Stories are only meaningful when they are factually accurate
Fiction has no connection to real life

vocabulary.definition: the breaking of something into separate, disconnected parts
accepting things without taking an active role
clever or deliberate contrivance used to create an effect
a style of writing that represents life as it actually is

paragraph_translations: Постмодерністська проза часто відмовляється від стабільного наративного центру, і прикладом цього є роман Італо Кальвіно «Якщо однієї зимової ночі мандрівник». Роман починається зі звернення безпосередньо до читача, а потім неодноразово перериває власну історію, щоб почати нові. Така фрагментація змушує читача ставати активним учасником, а не пасивним отримувачем значення. Цей прийом часто сприймають як коментар до самого акту читання.

Проте експериментальні структури не є лише грою. Багато критиків стверджують, що руйнування лінійного сюжету викриває припущення щодо влади, ідентичності та істини, які традиційний реалізм залишає без уваги. Звертаючи увагу на власну штучність, текст нагадує читачеві, що кожна історія побудована. Результат є твором, який водночас розважає і вимагає інтелектуальних зусиль.
